tensor_packet.cross_link_guard_definition: No cross-core tensor producer-consumer core pair and no direct eligible op-op edge crossing cores.

physical_frontier_certificate_A_only.scope: singleton P2 local Step2 bucket envelope; no global peak or Makespan guarantee

gap_packet.cross_link_guard_definition: No cross-core tensor producer-consumer core pair and no direct eligible op-op edge crossing cores.

_comparison.heuristic_trigger_definition: Diagnostic-only strict preference for A if A has no cross-core links, physical_frontier certificate A passes, and U_A < L_B. False means the sufficient diagnostic condition is not met; it does not prefer B.
_comparison.U_A_definition: max over A per-core sums of official schedule_step3._op_duration for eligible ops + A normalized base-copy service W_A; W_A excludes spill and cross-core fixed delay.
_comparison.L_B_definition: B normalized base-copy service W_B=sum(max(1,ceil(copy_bytes/config_bandwidth))) per mandatory copy; a service-demand lower bound, not an E0 prediction.
_comparison.raw_saved_M_role: Existing official E0 measurements only; not recomputed and not used by the trigger.
